Bolt torque specifications for flange assembly FA-D-100:

Bolt size: M24 x 3.0, Grade 8.8
Required torque: 450 Nm ± 5%
Tightening sequence: Star pattern, 3 passes (30%, 60%, 100%)
Lubricant: Molykote P-37 anti-seize compound

Gasket: Spiral wound, 316SS/graphite, ASME B16.20
Flange rating: ASME Class 300, RF (Raised Face)
Service: High-pressure steam, 280°C, 38 bar

Notes:
- All bolts must be replaced if any corrosion pitting exceeds 0.5 mm depth
- Flange faces must be inspected for damage before assembly
- Gasket must never be reused
- Final torque verification required 24 hours after initial tightening
